messages:
alex: Heads-up — want to kick off a short planning thread for the visibility workstream (dashboards, traces, error analysis, retention). Need to lock OKRs + launch criteria for the next quarter. Who can join?

morgan: I'm free to help. We should fold in the enterprise retention asks from Acme and Nimbus — they pushed 12+ month retention and S3 export.

jamie: Noted. 12+ months is non-trivial. Storage + query cost spikes. We'll need tiered storage + archive pipeline.

ellie: Proposal idea: baseline 30d retention for all customers, enterprise tier for 13mo with potting to S3/GCS. Also add query-time sampling to keep UI latency sane.

thai: Agree on tiers. Also we need a trace sampling UI (per-service sampling) and a trace detail perf view — customers want quick flame graphs.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: new infra-visibility branch built (build/visibility-2026.03.20) — CI green. :robot_face:

alex: Draft launch criteria I want to validate:
- Dashboards: core org + route-level cost/latency panels, basic alerting rules, export to CSV.
- Traces: distributed trace viewer, service map, per-trace timeline + span detail.
- Error analysis: automatic grouping, one-click drill to traces for each grouping.
- Retention: baseline 30d + enterprise opt-in to 13mo with object export.
- Performance: median dashboard load <200ms, p95 <600ms for standard retention.

morgan: Those look reasonable. Can we add acceptance around cost visibility (per-token + per-query breakdowns) so customers can see retention cost impact?

jamie: We need rough cost ballpark to present. Quick estimate: 13mo trace retention (hot + warm) increases storage by ~9x vs 30d. Rolling numbers: approx +$25k/month/TB of active trace data (very rough). Need SRE validation.

ellie: Also add QA gating: canary with 3 pilot customers, automated regression for query latency, sampling accuracy checks (compare sampled vs full for a test window).

thai: Product asks: SSO + audit logs for retention exports, and a simple pricing toggle in the billing console. Also docs + migration guide.

alex: OKRs to propose:
- Increase visibility product adoption to 40% of mid-market customers by EOY.
- Reduce median dashboard load time to <150ms.
- Ship retention tier + export with SSO & audit for enterprise customers.

morgan: Owner assignment suggestion: I own retention pricing & pilot run.
jamie: I'll own infra changes (storage lifecycle, query paths) and perf optimizations.
ellie: QA & canary owner. I'll set up test harness and sampling regressions.
thai: I'll write product docs, migration guide, and coordinate pilot comms.

alex: Nice — next steps for this thread:
1) Jamie to share rough infra cost delta by EOD Fri.
2) Morgan to draft pilot customer list + outreach template.
3) Ellie to prototype sampling regression and canary checklist.
4) Thai to draft pricing toggle UI mock and export SSO requirements.

Please add anything I missed. :eyes:

morgan: I'll add Acme + Nimbus + BetaCorp to the pilot list. Will ping SEs.
jamie: Will check with infra about cold storage lifecycle and possible compression/quantization options.
ellie: I'll start a QA doc and include telemetry-driven test cases.
thai: Will mock a simple billing toggle and share screenshots in #design later today.
sre-bot: incident-bot: reminder: maintenance window 03/22 02:00-04:00 UTC — might affect canary deploys.

alex: Thanks all. If no objections I'll pull this into the roadmap deck and OKR draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
